items: CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 9.6): Executes Project Grow Agrarian Expansion, Commences ₦50k Cash Transfer & Commissions Ikom Oxygen Plant
LAGOS STATE (PSI 9.4): Engages NBA on Land Bureau Reforms, Flags Off Polio Immunisation & Hosts World Bank HOPE Mission
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 9.2): Gov. Mutfwang Outlines ₦1.5Bn Insecurity Fund Distribution, 1,000 Forest Guards & VIO Operations Resume
KOGI STATE (PSI 9.0): Gov. Ododo Remodels 150 Solar Primary Health Facilities, Flags Off Dekina/Ibaji Roads & Airport Works
ENUGU STATE (PSI 8.8): Gov. Mbah Deploys 112 Emergency Response System & Mandates Development Centre Appointees on Grassroots Mandate
JIGAWA STATE (PSI 8.7): Gov. Namadi Partners Islamic Development Bank for $110M SMART Education & School Infrastructure Project
GOMBE STATE (PSI 8.6): Gov. Inuwa Proposes Regional Barewa-Model Special Schools & Hosts BOBA Biennial Conference
EDO STATE (PSI 8.5): Gov. Okpebholo Assures Cash Assistance & Modern Reconstruction for Oluku Market Explosion Victims
ZAMFARA STATE (PSI 8.4): Inaugurates Anti-Illegal Mining Committee & Establishes Persons with Disabilities Board Framework
EBONYI STATE (PSI 8.3): Gov. Nwifuru Champions Family Stability & Women Protection at 10th Moms Connect Conference
NASARAWA STATE (PSI 8.2): Gov. Sule Inspects Pioneer Public Relations University Construction & Mararaba Twin Flyover Works
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 8.1): Commissions 200-Poles-Per-Day Concrete Electricity Plant & Conducts Rural Ministry Performance Review
BENUE STATE (PSI 8.0): Gov. Alia Warns Against Political Violence, Urges Issue-Based 2027 Democratic Campaigns in Buruku
BAYELSA STATE (PSI 7.9): Prepares to Launch 'Bayelsa Ebidou' Investment Campaign Highlighting Gas Power & Infrastructure
DELTA STATE (PSI 7.8): Condemns Asaba Political Violence & Directs Police Investigation into Fatal Rally Clashes
KWARA STATE (PSI 7.7): Gov. AbdulRazaq Celebrates Team Kwara's 5th National Presidential Debate Victory & SUBEB Award
RIVERS STATE (PSI 7.6): Gov. Fubara Reinstates Governing Council Members of Ignatius Ajuru University of Education
TARABA STATE (PSI 7.5): Gov. Kefas Preaches Servant Leadership at Yola Kingdom Conference & Lays School Foundation
AKWA IBOM STATE (PSI 7.4): President Tinubu Commissions ARISE Palm Resort & Modern Security Command & Control Centre
ABIA STATE (PSI 7.3): Concludes 2nd Tertiary Education Sports Fiesta (ASTESF) with MOUAU Emerging Overall Winner
NIGER STATE (PSI 7.2): Gov. Bago Attends 8th SHOUT Christian Gathering & Reaffirms Freedom of Worship and Peace
YOBE STATE (PSI 7.1): Gov. Buni Advocates Global & National Partnerships at Yobe Partnership Roundtable in Abuja

CROSS RIVER (PSI 9.6): Gov. Bassey Otu expanded Project Grow soybean clusters under an ₦18bn FMN offtake deal, began ₦50k cash transfers across 196 wards to 29,400 beneficiaries, commissioned an Ikom medical oxygen plant, and enrolled 1,666 vulnerable persons into CRSHIA via SSDC.

LAGOS (PSI 9.4): Lagos Lands Bureau engaged the NBA on centralized archiving; LASG clarified groundwater permit laws; LSPHCB flagged off Sub-National Immunisation Days in Ikorodu; and Lagos prepared to host the South-West World Bank HOPE-GOV mission.

PLATEAU (PSI 9.2): Gov. Mutfwang announced 1,000 forest guards in training, ₦1.5bn First Lady/State insecurity fund disbursements, ₦10m seed funding per district for widows, and 11 road projects; VIO road operations resume while SOCU sensitized Riyom/Ganawuri on National Social Register.

KOGI (PSI 9.0): Gov. Ahmed Usman Ododo remodeled 150+ solar PHCs with free maternal care, flagged off 30km Bunu and Ogane-Enugu cashew corridor roads, advanced Kogi Airport construction, and planted 5 million cashew/oil palm seedlings.

ENUGU (PSI 8.8): Gov. Peter Mbah charged newly sworn-in Development Centre administrators to drive grassroots governance, deployed the Enugu 112 Emergency Response System, and reinforced agribusiness partnerships targeting a $12bn agro-economy by 2031.

JIGAWA (PSI 8.7): Gov. Umar Namadi met with an IsDB delegation led by Imtiaz Alam to finalize the preparation of a $110m SMART project for school construction, water/sanitation, and teacher capacity, following 10,000 teacher recruitments.

GOMBE (PSI 8.6): Gov. Inuwa Yahaya received BOBA national leadership led by Maj. Gen. Alwali Jauji Kazir (rtd), proposing special secondary schools modeled after Barewa College across Northern states to tackle out-of-school children.

EDO (PSI 8.5): Gov. Monday Okpebholo assured victims of the Oluku market tanker explosion of post-reconstruction cash support and a modern concrete market; Edo-CSDA conducted field appraisals across 7 communities for solar lighting, power, and water.

ZAMFARA (PSI 8.4): Gov. Lawal, represented by SSG Malam Abubakar Nakwada, inaugurated the State Anti-Illegal Mining Committee under Environment Commissioner Dr. Abdurrahman Tumbido; Persons with Disabilities Board announced free healthcare and 5% job quota.

EBONYI (PSI 8.3): Gov. Francis Nwifuru addressed the Queens Conference alongside CJN Justice Kudirat Kekere-Ekun and Appeal Court Justice Uchechukwu Onyemenam, reaffirming state institutional protection for women and children via the Public Defender's Office.

NASARAWA (PSI 8.2): Gov. Sule inspected the construction of the University of Public Relations and Leadership alongside Global Alliance President Prof. Justin Green and NIPR President Dr. Ike Neliaku; he also monitored progress on the Mararaba Twin Flyover.

ADAMAWA (PSI 8.1): Deputy Gov. Prof. Kaletapwa George Farauta commissioned Rhossili International's electricity pole factory in Yola (200 poles/day capacity); Ministry of Rural Infrastructure reviewed October rural development project achievements.

BENUE (PSI 8.0): Gov. Hyacinth Alia called on political actors to shun violence and inflammatory rhetoric in Buruku LGA, emphasizing issue-based campaigns and democratic maturity ahead of 2027 elections.

BAYELSA (PSI 7.9): Bayelsa Government New Media announced the upcoming launch of the 'Bayelsa Ebidou' campaign at NIPR Week, highlighting steady gas turbine electricity, road networks to coastal hubs, and top security ratings.

DELTA (PSI 7.8): Delta State Government condemned political violence in Asaba that resulted in 1 death and 4 injuries, calling on the police command to investigate and prosecute organizers who ignored security advisories.

KWARA (PSI 7.7): Gov. AbdulRazaq commended Kwara pupils for winning the 2026 Presidential School Debate for a 5th time, while congratulating SUBEB Chairman Prof. Sheu Adaramaja on his award as Best SUBEB Chairman in Nigeria.

RIVERS (PSI 7.6): Gov. Siminalayi Fubara reinstated 6 members of the Governing Council of Ignatius Ajuru University of Education (IAUE) with immediate effect to strengthen institutional administration.
TARABA (PSI 7.5): Gov. Agbu Kefas preached servant leadership at The Praise Church conference in Yola, Adamawa State, and laid the foundation for the Taraba State block at Agape Academy.
AKWA IBOM (PSI 7.4): President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, alongside Gov. Umo Eno, commissioned the ARISE Palm Resort and the Security Command & Control Centre in Uyo to boost real-time surveillance.
ABIA (PSI 7.3): Gov. Alex Otti closed the 2nd Abia State Tertiary Education Sports Fiesta in Umuahia featuring 1,800 students from 18 institutions, with MOUAU winning overall.
NIGER (PSI 7.2): Gov. Bago attended the 8th edition of 'SHOUT' at Minna Trade Fair Complex, pledging continuous support for religious harmony and peaceful coexistence.
YOBE (PSI 7.1): Gov. Mai Mala Buni hosted the Yobe Development and Partnership Roundtable in Abuja, calling for national and international development partnerships.
